question: What is the driving force and executive body of the European Union (EU)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**European Commission**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** European Commission (EC) **is the executive body of the European Union (EU)
 
• The** EC uses its "right of initiative" to propose new laws and policies.**
 
• The** European Parliament and the Council of the European Union then review and adopt these proposal**
 
• The EC manages the EU budget and allocates funding. 
 
• The EC **enforces EU law with the Court of Justice**
 
• The EC** represents the EU internationally, for example, by negotiating agreements with other countries**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 European Union:

 
• The European Union was established on November 1, 1993, in Maastricht, Netherlands.
 
• The European Union (EU) is a political and economic union, consisting of 27 member states after the exit of Great Britain.
 
• Presently, 24 countries located on the continent of Europe, are not part of the European Union.
 
• It is headquartered in Brussels, the capital of Belgium.
 
• In order for the EU to adopt policies that concern defense and foreign affairs, all member states must agree unanimously.
 
• For the EU to choose policies that interest defense and foreign affairs, all member states must agree collectively.
